topics.topic: Which Customer actions may expose the stored create request id
questions: Which product actions may read this fact: only a retried record-customer operation internally, or also owner customer reads or lists?
Which Customer-returning actions, if any, expose the stored create request id before erasure?
Which product actions, if any, return a Customer's create request id: the record response, customer read, customer list, billing read, or none?

quotes:
8. A request id is never an identity: it is not answered as one, and no read
   looks a record up by it.
judgement.why: State 2 decides that the Customer create request id is retained for replay handling but is not exposed by a read.

topics.topic: Who originates the Room create request id for owner and Kernel-agent paths and whether it is mandatory
questions: Who creates and supplies the request id for each add-room path: the Registry-served owner interface for owner calls and Cabinet Kernel for agent calls, or some other principal or component?
For an agent-authority add-room action, who originates the request id: Cabinet Kernel from its run context or the agent-authored operation input passed through Kernel?
For each ordinary room creation, must a request id be supplied, and who supplies it when the actor is the owner versus an agent through Kernel?

quotes:
1. 'Create a project', 'record a customer' and 'add a room' each carry a
   request id: an opaque value the caller makes, unique for every create it
   means as new. The owner interface makes one when it renders a create form;
   Cabinet Kernel gives one as an input field of 'add a room' (R0-78).
6. A create without a request id is refused.
judgement.why: State 2 says the owner interface makes the owner-path id, Cabinet Kernel supplies the agent-path id, and every ordinary add-room create requires one.
